title: SIDESTORY: DARKNIGHTS MEMOIR - RERUN OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Darknights Memoir event stages will be open for a limited-time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
DETAILS: During the event, “Hit List” event missions will be available, the missions can be completed in the event stages.
MAIN REWARDS: 5* Event Bonus Operator Sideroca, Seven Cities-Style Restaurant Furniture (Pieces), Anonymous Tags.
DETAILS: Players can collect Anonymous Tags through completing Event Stages and “Hit List” event missions to redeem items from Scar Market.
MAIN REWARDS: Sideroca's Token, Seven Cities-Style Restaurant Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Furniture Part, Elite Materials, etc.
During this rerun event, the stage progress from its first release will be kept and the first-clear reward will not be reset

During this rerun event, some rewards that cannot be obtained repeatedly will be converted into Intelligence Certificate in corresponding conversion rate. Please check the Intelligence Certificate Converting Rules in the event for more details
The quantity of items in Intelligence Certificate Store will be increased and some new items will be added into Intelligence Certificate Store when the event begins
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – ILLUSIONS OF THE PAST
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Illusions of the Past", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
*Phantom, Shamare, Cutter, Sideroca, W, Weedy and Elysium will gain more trust in event stages.
03 EARLY AUTUMN PICKS RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
MARTHE - Ready to Go for Zima
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – SEVEN CITIES - STYLE RESTAURANT
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
Darknights Memoir event rewards and redeem in Scar Market (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from September 7, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 21, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
